title: Indian Meadows Golf Course
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Indian Meadows Golf Club is open to the public throughout the golf season. The course stretches 6,530 yards from the back tees, and offers a selection of three different tees on each hole. Indian Meadows’ strategically placed bunkers border the small greens, and water comes into play on many holes.
